A mini tiffin is a small-portion plate of several South Indian tiffin items served together, so you can taste more than one dish in a single order. Typical combinations may include items such as idli, pongal, vada, a sweet and a dosa.

Nellai is the everyday name for Tirunelveli in southern Tamil Nadu. Nellai-style meals follow that region's home-cooking style, with dishes such as sodhi, a mild coconut-milk gravy. Brihadhee serves Nellai meals in Anna Nagar.

Sodhi is a mild, fragrant, coconut-milk based vegetable gravy from Tirunelveli (Nellai) cooking. It is usually eaten with idli, idiyappam, parotta or rice. It is light rather than hot, which makes it a good first taste of Nellai food.

Filter coffee is South Indian coffee made by dripping hot water through ground coffee in a metal filter. The strong decoction is mixed with hot milk and sugar and served hot, often in a steel tumbler and dabara. Brihadhee serves filter coffee.
